research_result.description: BigCommerce is an ecommerce platform offering REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for building storefronts, integrations, and AI agent toolkits.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can sign up for a free trial or create a partner sandbox store. Store-level API credentials and access tokens are created in the store control panel under Settings > API Accounts, while app-level OAuth credentials are created in the Developer Portal.

evidence.claim: BigCommerce supports OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant for app integration.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: BigCommerce uses a modified version of the OAuth2 authorization code grant (tools.ietf.org).

evidence.claim: BigCommerce supports bearer tokens for authenticating GraphQL Storefront API requests.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The GraphQL API authorizes requests with a bearer token sent via the HTTP Authorization header:

evidence.claim: Free sandbox stores are available for developing and testing applications.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Sandbox stores are intended for developing and testing apps. They cannot process any live transactions.

evidence.claim: BigCommerce provides REST APIs with standard HTTP status codes and filtering parameters.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: This page covers REST API HTTP status codes and common query parameters for BigCommerce REST APIs.

evidence.claim: BigCommerce offers GraphQL Admin and Storefront APIs.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The GraphQL Admin API is similar in concept to REST admin APIs but handles different domains of operations.

evidence.claim: BigCommerce provides dedicated Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for AI agents.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The BigCommerce MCP server lets AI agents interact with a BigCommerce storefront using purpose-built commerce tools.
